summary: A small task from a blank file: you take the better prompt apart one rule at a time (an ablation), score five questions with simple checks each time, and read which rule matters. The model is a simulated stand-in that follows the rules it finds, so the loop can be practised with no key.
goal: Take a prompt apart one rule at a time, score each version, and read what matters, from a blank file.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then read the contract
Step 1: add the given simulated model, evaluate.py and the exact-code change, and see the tests pass
Step 2: write break_and_fix.py and match the six lines
Step 3: add a variant without rules 3 and 4, predict the score, then check
Step 4: explain why rule 1 and the examples change nothing, and what you would try for the price question
Play the Ablation Lab game to the end and see your score
